summary: Master affordable housing finance and delivery models with practical pro formas, capital stacks, and funding strategies. Enrol to sharpen deal analysis.
lede: Affordable housing finance training covers how to assess project feasibility and organize funding and delivery plans. It is for developers, housing finance officers, project managers and analysts who work with housing projects and funding decisions. Participants practice building pro formas, testing debt sizing and assumptions, designing capital stacks, comparing delivery models, and reviewing subsidy and lender requirements to prepare financing recommendations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with housing projects, funding decisions, or development approvals and need stronger applied skills in affordable housing finance and delivery models.
audience: Capital markets or lender relationship staff
prerequisites: Participants should bring a laptop with Microsoft Excel installed and a basic understanding of project budgets or financial statements. A calculator is useful, and prior exposure to housing development, public subsidy programmes, or real estate appraisal will help you move faster through the exercises.
